firstPlayerRule: Each player draws a card; the highest number deals (symbol cards count as zero). The person to the left of the dealer starts play.
houseFallback: If players tie for the highest number, those players draw again.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Mattel service-site instruction PDF and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "Each player draws a card; the player that draws the highest number deals (count any card with a symbol as zero)." "LET’S PLAY The person to the left of the dealer starts play." © 2019 Mattel.
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for equal high draws.
